title: Cookie Policy
intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Ebbatech Nigeria Limited uses browser cookies to remember your preferences and understand how visitors use our website.

sections.heading: Types of Cookies Used
sections.body: We use essential cookies to remember your cookie consent choice, and preference cookies to save your light/dark theme selection between visits.

sections.heading: Adjusting Preferences
sections.body: You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time. Doing so may affect minor interface preferences but will not prevent you from browsing the site or submitting an enquiry.
